title: From Deterministic to Generative Deep Learning for Urban Air Quality Reconstruction from Sparse Observations
abstract: arXiv:2607.25687v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Full-field reconstruction of air pollution is essential for evaluating pollution exposure and supporting public health decision-making. However, the complex interactions among pollutants, hard-to-predict weather patterns, and limited monitoring station coverage make this a complex task. We apply deep learning techniques to provide fast and accurate reconstructions from sparse observations of four key pollutants: NO2, O3, PM2.5 and PM10. Models are trained on full-field simulation data and evaluated on real-world observations collected from 9 to 28 monitoring stations in the city of Paris. We introduce a diffusion-based generative framework for multi-pollutant reconstruction and benchmark its performance against deterministic deep learning models. translated_title: 从确定性深度学习到生成式深度学习：基于稀疏观测的城市空气质量重建
translated_abstract: 空气污染的全场重建对于评估污染暴露和支持公共卫生决策至关重要。然而，污染物之间复杂的相互作用、难以预测的天气模式以及有限的监测站覆盖范围，使这项任务变得极具挑战性。我们应用深度学习技术，从四种关键污染物（NO2、O3、PM2.5和PM10）的稀疏观测中提供快速而准确的重建。模型在全模拟数据上进行训练，并在巴黎市9至28个监测站收集的真实世界观测数据上进行评估。我们引入了一种基于扩散模型的多污染物重建生成式框架，并将其性能与确定性深度学习模型进行基准对比。尽管观测数据存在噪声且空间变异性强，这些模型在模拟验证数据上仍实现了较高的结构相似性，并在真实世界数据上生成了逼真的空间分布模式。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的生成式深度学习框架，用于从稀疏观测中重建巴黎多种空气污染物（NO2、O3、PM2.5、PM10）的浓度场，并在与确定性深度学习模型的对比中展现出在真实观测数据上生成逼真空间分布的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a diffusion-based generative deep learning framework for reconstructing multi-pollutant air quality fields (NO2, O3, PM2.5, PM10) from sparse observations, benchmarking it against deterministic deep learning models and demonstrating realistic spatial patterns on real-world data in Paris.
